name: KTeV detector

technology.value: Neutral-kaon spectrometer with electromagnetic (CsI) calorimetry, drift chambers, a transition radiation detector system and photon/particle veto systems, used to reconstruct KL decays to two pions/photons
technology.note: General technology description; a dedicated KTeV detector-paper full text was not fetched in this session (only design-report and conference-talk metadata), so this is recorded with reduced confidence.

intervals.label: operating
intervals.note: See experiment:ktev intervals for the same run-date caveats.

summary.plain: The KTeV detector combined a calorimeter, tracking chambers and veto systems to catch neutral kaons decaying, at Fermilab in the 1990s.
summary.technical: Fixed-target neutral-kaon spectrometer (E799-II/E832) with CsI electromagnetic calorimetry, drift-chamber tracking, a transition-radiation detector system and hermetic photon/charged-particle vetoes.

notes: Placed at site:fermilab-ktev-hall, created by this same workstream.
